净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Smooth blend between earnings yield and book yield with leverage penalty, weighted by time-series size z-score via logistic function. This preserves the core economic intuition of size-adaptive value while improving signal continuity and reducing binary switch noise, targeting IC/ICIR improvement.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

weight = 1/(1+exp(-clip(size_z,-10,10))), output = weight * (1/pe_ttm) + (1-weight) * (1/pb_lf) * max(0, 1-debttoassets/100)
依赖列: mkt_cap_float, pe_ttm, pb_lf, debttoassets

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(divide(1, add(1, exp((-clip(divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 252)), -1, 1))))), add(multiply(divide(1, pe_ttm), 0.5), multiply(1.5, 1)))
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, add(1, exp((-clip(divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 252)), -1, 1)))))
  3. 3. add —— 加法
    add(1, exp((-clip(divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 252)), -1, 1))))
  4. 4. exp —— 取指数
    exp((-clip(divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 252)), -1, 1)))
  5. 5. clip —— 裁剪到区间[下限,上限]
    clip(divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 252)), -1, 1)
  6. 6. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 252))
  7. 7. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 252)
  8. 8. add —— 加法
    add(multiply(divide(1, pe_ttm), 0.5), multiply(1.5, 1))
  9. 9. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(divide(1, pe_ttm), 0.5)
  10. 10. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, pe_ttm)
  11. 11. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(1.5, 1)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
exp计算 e 的 x 次方

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 1) book_yield = eps_ttm / pb_lf ROE 代理 (盈利/账面)
  2. 2) size_penalty = abs(log(close)) 市值对数 (大市值权重大)
  3. 3) score = -size_penalty * book_yield 小市值 + 高 ROE 占优
  4. 4) ema(span=10, score) 平滑
  5. 5) factor = cs_rank(...)
来源：手写步骤（factor_manual_61 / formula_lqtp 人工核对）

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. clip(size_z,-10,10) — clip(x, lo, hi) → 裁剪到区间
  2. max(0, 1-debttoassets/100) — max(x, n) → 滚动最大 / 逐点最大

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_ts_size_adaptive_earnings_book_smooth(df): df_copy = df.copy() size_mean = df_copy["str">'mkt_cap_float'].rolling(60, min_periods=20).mean() size_std = df_copy["str">'mkt_cap_float'].rolling(60, min_periods=20).std(ddof=0) size_z = (df_copy["str">'mkt_cap_float'] - size_mean) / size_std.replace(0, np.nan) size_z = np.clip(size_z, -10, 10) ey = 1.0 / df_copy["str">'pe_ttm'].replace(0, np.nan) by = 1.0 / df_copy["str">'pb_lf'].replace(0, np.nan) lev = df_copy["str">'debttoassets'] / 100.0 lev_penalty = (1.0 - lev).clip(lower=0.0) weight = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-size_z)) df_copy["str">'factor_ts_size_adaptive_earnings_book_smooth'] = weight * ey + (1.0 - weight) * by * lev_penalty "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_ts_size_adaptive_earnings_book_smooth']
